comparator.name: Econometrics and Data Science
comparator.sourceNotes: The official 2026–27 annual schedule specifies ten compulsory 6-EC courses in each of Years 1 and 2, an open 30-EC minor period, a compulsory 12-EC thesis and a choice of three 6-EC subjects from seven in Year 3. Econometrics III, Machine Learning for Econometrics and Data Science, and Fair, Transparent and Interpretable Machine Learning are one valid elective selection, fixed from the VU course list before considering UCR fit; the other four options remain choices rather than requirements. The zero-credit SAM line and optional honours are excluded. The programme-specific OER says Years 1–2 are taught in English with Dutch expression, tutorial and examination-answer options, and Year 3 in English. This nuance differs from the registry NLD language flag; no separate Dutch-only pathway is assumed.

How can data estimate advertising effects and inform business decisions?
How can machine-learning decisions be made fair and interpretable?

alternatives.label: Econometrics and data science for economic forecasting
alternatives.concept: A mathematical, statistical and computational spine leads to econometrics and machine learning, with macroeconomics, finance and behavioural economics as application fields. It approaches the VU degree without claiming the same three-course econometrics depth or the 12-EC research thesis.
alternatives.labelReason: Econometric and machine-learning methods are applied to economic and financial questions, with ethical analysis included.
progression: Six four-course semesters from Fall 2026 through Spring 2029; first-year PPD, at least six 300-level courses, verified term offerings and earlier formal prerequisites against the enriched UCR workbook.

alternatives.label: Consumer and marketing data analysis
alternatives.concept: Retains the quantitative spine, econometrics, machine learning and responsible AI, while focusing on consumer engagement, market research, business organisation and international business applications. This is a related UCR direction for demand and advertising questions, not a VU marketing specialisation.
alternatives.labelReason: Marketing, market research, business and governance courses make consumer and firm decisions the central application.
progression: Six four-course semesters from Fall 2026 through Spring 2029; first-year PPD, at least six 300-level courses, verified term offerings and earlier formal prerequisites against the enriched UCR workbook.
alternatives.distinctness: Five courses change: Business Foundations, Marketing & Consumer Engagement, Business & Economy in the Age of AI, International Business & Governance and Market Research replace Accounting & Corporate Finance, International Macroeconomics, Logic & Discrete Mathematics, Reinforcement Learning and Behavioral Economics. The 37.5-EC shift changes the application from macroeconomic and financial forecasting to consumer and business evidence.

candidates.label: Consumer demand, advertising and business analytics
Fair, responsible and interpretable machine learning

selection.assessment: The closest path owns the common mathematical, econometric and data-science interests, including fairness. Consumer demand and advertising effects support a distinct five-course shift toward market and business evidence and become a second UCR path. Responsible ML is integrated in both through AI Ethics and quantitative study; UCR has no dedicated differential-privacy or interpretable-ML sequence to support another distinct 24-course programme. Further career and illustrative topics do not generate alternatives.

notes.text: VU has successive Econometrics I–III, multivariate statistics, data science practical and project, a dedicated fairness/interpretability elective and a 12-EC quantitative thesis alongside the open 30-EC minor. UCR offers one Econometrics course, mathematics, statistics, algorithms, machine learning and AI ethics, but not the same advanced econometrics, privacy or independent thesis sequence. The registry NLD language flag also warrants review against VU’s 2026–27 English teaching rule with Dutch options in Years 1–2.
